evidenceRead.profile: Studies moral reasoning through historical and contemporary ethical theories and close philosophical reading. audience.programmeDescription: Entrepreneurship and Business Innovation at Tilburg University studies how new ventures and existing organisations develop ideas into economic and societal value. Business theory, quantitative methods, programming and personal development support four Entrepreneurship in Action projects and a graduation project.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The broad UCR option combines venture and product development with marketing, economics, leadership, financial study and research. These programmes leave gaps in Tilburg’s four-project practice sequence, dedicated entrepreneurship contexts, specialist entrepreneurial finance and compulsory graduation project.

notes.text: Tilburg requires four successive Entrepreneurship in Action projects, dedicated startup/corporate/impact courses, a chosen advanced specialisation and a 12-EC graduation project.
